exposure: Infant feeding mode at 3 months (direct breastfeeding only, breastfeeding with some expressed breast milk, breast milk and formula, or formula only)
breastfeeding with some expressed breast milk
cohort: 3296 children in the Canadian Healthy Infant Longitudinal Development birth cohort
finding: Compared to direct breastfeeding, any other mode of infant feeding was associated with an increased risk of asthma at 3 years of age.
